verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships a first-party MCP Server that is explicitly documented for managing an Auth0 tenant through natural language with AI tools like Claude Desktop (auth0-docs-13, auth0-docs-60, auth0-probe-4). The docs and GitHub repo describe multi-step operations through it, such as creating apps, managing users, deploying Actions and debugging logs (auth0-docs-41, auth0-gh-1). Missing for 10: no native natural-language interface inside the dashboard itself (it requires an external AI client), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of how well natural-language operation works in practice.
